timeline.detail: JARVIS is ready to investigate a pull request.
PR #1 weakens session validation and removes its regression checks.
JARVIS has prepared three findings. No GitHub review comment has been posted.
Three specialists completed read-only GitHub analysis of PR #1; duplicate findings were merged.
JARVIS has prepared three evidence-backed findings. No GitHub review comment has been posted.

findings.title: Bearer scheme validation was removed
findings.description: Any non-empty authorization value is now accepted as an access token, so a Basic or malformed scheme can create an authenticated session.

evidence.detail: The Bearer regular expression was replaced with a simple string replacement.

findings.proposedComment: Please preserve strict Bearer scheme validation before accepting an access token.

findings.title: Refresh token input is no longer validated
findings.description: The refactor returns a session even when the refresh token is absent or malformed, expanding the unauthenticated input surface.

evidence.detail: The refresh-token type and length guard was removed from buildSessionContext.

findings.proposedComment: Keep the refresh-token guard or delegate equivalent validation to a trusted provider adapter.

findings.title: Regression coverage was removed with the guard
findings.description: The PR removes the tests that reject Basic authorization and malformed refresh tokens, so this behavior cannot be detected locally.

evidence.detail: Two invalid-token test cases were deleted while the validation paths changed.

findings.proposedComment: Restore negative tests for non-Bearer authorization and malformed refresh tokens before merging.

summary.message: 3 threats detected · 0 comments published · human approval required
